fixture.how: Four fixture modules are compiled with `lean -o` into a mktemp directory as GFNBounds.Paper.AppendixFixA, FixB, FixC, AppendixFixD (all import only GFNBounds.Paper.Attribute, none imports another). Because Lean resolves a module under the first search-path entry holding its root directory, the temp olean dir mirrors the package's built GFNBounds/ as symlinks plus the fixtures. Each scenario is a temporary copy of the exporter whose import line is extended (and, for one, a prelude spliced in), run with the temp directory as cwd, so the relative docs/ writes land there. Nothing is compiled into lean/.lake, no placement reaches any package .olean, and the sha256 of lean/docs/lean-facts.json is checked unchanged at the end. Exit 0 iff every scenario is as expected; LEAN_FACTS_SCRIPT overrides the exporter under test.

scenarios.pos (A + C): export succeeds; check_positive.py: every baseline object byte-identical except validLabel and labels, which differ only by an added paper key; validLabel paper = [lem:paperattr_test_export_same, lem:paperattr_test_export_c] (the identical pair from A and C deduplicated); FixA.asm paper + conjuncts [GFNBounds.Paper.FixA.zero_eq, GFNBounds.Paper.FixA.one_eq]; FixA.d (placed def in an Appendix module) paper, no conjuncts; FixC.single (placed theorem outside assembly modules) paper, no conjuncts; no other paper or conjuncts key; new keys only from the two fixture modules.
scenarios.dup (A + B + C): cross-module duplicate: A places lem:paperattr_test_export_dup on labels, B on validLabel.
scenarios.unwalked (A + C + prelude): a GFNBounds theorem declared in the exporter's main module carries a placement; the walk emits imported modules only.
scenarios.glue (A + C + D): a placed assembly theorem in GFNBounds.Paper.AppendixFixD with Nat.le_of_lt around a conjunct.

kb_proposals: Fixture modules for a script that reads imported oleans: compile them with `lean -R <src> -o <dir>/GFNBounds/...olean` into a temp dir that mirrors the package's .lake/build/lib/lean/GFNBounds tree as symlinks (`cp -rs`), because Lean resolves a module under the first LEAN_PATH entry that holds its root directory; a second GFNBounds/ tree on LEAN_PATH hides the package's own modules ('object file ... does not exist').

To test an export's throws without touching the tree: run a temp copy of the script with the temp directory as cwd (the script writes relative paths) and a sentinel output file; a throw before the write leaves the sentinel.

Proposal (needs tools/selftest.py, outside this dispatch): move the fixture to tools/fixtures/lean-facts/ with a run.sh that exits non-zero iff the exporter bites (e.g. `! bash .../run-scenarios.sh` per throw), and add 'lean/scripts/lean_facts.lean': 'lean-facts' to GATES; or add a `facts-selftest` target to lean/Makefile that the hub's lib-check runs, since it needs a built lean/ anyway.

Proposal: make lean_facts.lean call GFNBounds.Paper.isProject/isNoise instead of its LeanFacts copies, so the attribute's namespace test and the walk cannot drift (the not-emitted throw then guards only the module-selection difference).
